request:
镜头 s11：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 11 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-lab50s）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Super 16', 'Vision3 500T']）：Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景。宋工指着两只铁盒，压低声音但很兴奋地说完；波爷抱着胳膊，反问了一句。环境声：机房嗡鸣。
情绪：excited, conspiratorial, sceptical
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld with a slow drift from Song to Boye
景深与虚实：Natural depth of field; both men sharp, the server hall soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Handheld documentary medium shot in the lab at night: Song, animated but quiet, gestures between two dented tin boxes on the bench while Boye stands with his arms crossed, half-convinced. Blocking lock: Song at frame left gesturing toward the two tin boxes on the bench in the lower centre, Boye at frame right with arms crossed; the glass wall and the red lens in the soft background.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
Picture 3: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
Picture 4: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 不用问中心。它们自己找到彼此，分活儿干，干完留张回执。
2. Boye at forty-four (male voice, brisk, slightly gruff and stubborn) — 四十四岁的波爷（男声，干脆、略带倔强）: 那还要中心干什么？
现场环境声：server hall hum, a chair creaking
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[rules/move/handheld-slight] move
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
[ours/trans-jl] 转场：J剪与L剪
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
